fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: Maria needs someone to help her. She wants you to deliver a letter to Lucas inAmherst.
fields.after: Maria needs someone to help her. She wants me to deliver a letter to Lucas in Amherst.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: You delivered Maria's Letter to Lucas in Amherst.
fields.after: I delivered Maria's Letter to Lucas in Amherst.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: I delivered the Horny Mushroom Caps and Wild Boar Tooths to Jane. I wonder if this will really change her father's mind... she's wearing bunny ears, for goodness sake! Ah well, it's none of my business. In return, Jane gave me a Scroll for ATT. My weapon's going to be awesome... if the scroll works.
fields.after: I delivered the Blue Mushroom Caps and Horny Mushroom Caps to Jane. I wonder if this will really change her father's mind... she's wearing bunny ears, for goodness sake! Ah well, it's none of my business. In return, Jane gave me a Scroll for ATT. My weapon's going to be awesome... if the scroll works.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I ran into Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys, who is overcome with concern. She says there aren't enough decorations for the village festival, and asks you to get 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons.
fields.after: I ran into Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys, who was overcome with concern. She said there aren't enough decorations for the village festival, and asked me to bring 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons.

fields.label: Description
fields.before: A mysterious water gathered from the deepest valleys of Ellinia. It can extend a living pet’s active time, and if you bring it to Mar the fairy in Ellinia, she can restore a pet that has turned into a doll.
fields.after: A mysterious water gathered from the deepest valleys of Ellinia. It can extend a living pet's active time, and if you bring it to Mar the fairy in Ellinia, she can restore a pet that has turned into a doll.
